cf7517adbe.q: What is the key difference between change management and training in Microsoft Dynamics implementations?
cf7517adbe.a: Training is just a piece of the jigsaw, not the full change management process. Real change management involves resistance management, understanding what people are afraid of, taking each person on their own change journey, and ensuring user adoption. Many partners see training as change management when it is not enough to drive real transformation.

58ea36acd7.q: Why do Microsoft Dynamics ERP implementation projects fail when customers and partners have misaligned success criteria?
58ea36acd7.a: The partner's success is aligned to go-live because that's when invoices are generated, while the customer sees go-live as just the start of realizing value. After go-live, partners move to the next project while customers are still looking for operational improvements. This misalignment, combined with breakdowns in people relationships and trust rather than technology issues, causes projects to fail.
